kategorie.aesthetik.beschreibung.text: Treatments that are about how your teeth look: colour, shape, position and how they work together with your face.

kategorie.angst.beschreibung.text: For everyone who keeps putting off the dentist: treatment under sedation, with nitrous oxide or under general anaesthetic.

kategorie.chirurgie.beschreibung.text: Surgical procedures in the mouth: wisdom teeth, extractions, bone grafting – with experience and a gentle technique.

kategorie.funktion.beschreibung.text: When jaw, muscles and teeth no longer work together: grinding, TMJ disorders, jaw joint pain and tension.

kategorie.implantologie.beschreibung.text: Artificial tooth roots as a firm foundation for a single tooth, a bridge or a complete jaw.

kategorie.kieferorthopaedie.beschreibung.text: Correcting misaligned teeth – with almost invisible aligners or classic braces, for children and adults.

kategorie.kinder.beschreibung.text: Dentistry that does not frighten children – from the very first check-up to treating chalky teeth.

kategorie.vorsorge.beschreibung.text: Everything that keeps larger treatments from becoming necessary in the first place – from professional cleaning to early detection.

kategorie.zahnerhalt.beschreibung.text: Saving your own tooth instead of replacing it – root canal treatment, gum disease therapy and gentle fillings.

kategorie.zahnersatz.beschreibung.text: When tooth structure is missing: fillings, inlays, crowns, bridges and dentures – made in our own master laboratory.

leistung.aligner.dauer.text: 6 to 18 months, depending on your starting position

leistung.aligner.faq.0.antwort.text: At least 20 to 22 hours – in other words, all the time except when eating or brushing your teeth. This is the point where treatments succeed or fail. If you don't keep to the wearing time, the treatment will take considerably longer.

leistung.aligner.faq.0.frage.text: How many hours a day do I need to wear the aligner?

leistung.aligner.faq.1.antwort.text: Barely, at normal conversation distance. If so-called attachments – small tooth-coloured bumps – are needed, these may be visible up close.

leistung.aligner.faq.1.frage.text: Can people see the aligners when I speak?

leistung.aligner.faq.2.antwort.text: Only with a retainer. Teeth naturally tend to drift back to their old position. That's why permanent stabilisation is needed after any orthodontic treatment – usually a thin wire behind the front teeth.

leistung.aligner.faq.2.frage.text: Will my teeth stay straight afterwards?

leistung.aligner.kasse.text: For adults, this is usually a private (self-pay) treatment. For children and young people, the statutory health insurance covers it from misalignment grade KIG 3 onwards – though this usually means fixed braces rather than aligners.

leistung.aligner.kurz.text: Straighten your teeth with clear aligners instead of fixed braces.

leistung.aligner.patientenfrage.text: How long does aligner treatment take for adults?

leistung.aligner.teaser.text: Aligners are removable, transparent trays that move your teeth in small steps. They're hardly noticeable in everyday life, and you simply take them out to eat or brush your teeth. For mild to moderate misalignments, they're a very good alternative to fixed braces.

leistung.all-on-4.dauer.text: Procedure 2 to 4 hours, final restoration after 3 to 6 months

leistung.all-on-4.faq.0.antwort.text: Yes, if they are positioned correctly. The two back implants are placed at an angle to make the best use of the available bone. This method has been documented for over twenty years. If the bone conditions are less favourable, we use six implants instead.

leistung.all-on-4.faq.0.frage.text: Are four implants really enough for a whole jaw?

leistung.all-on-4.faq.1.antwort.text: The temporary teeth are fixed, but not yet able to bear full pressure. For around three months, we recommend soft food and avoiding anything very hard. After that, the final bridge can be used without restriction.

leistung.all-on-4.faq.1.frage.text: What can I eat in the first few weeks?

leistung.all-on-4.kasse.text: Fixed subsidy for the comparable standard treatment. Payment in instalments is possible.

leistung.all-on-4.kurz.text: A complete jaw supported by four implants – with a fixed temporary set of teeth on the same day.

leistung.all-on-4.patientenfrage.text: Can I really get fixed teeth in just one day?

leistung.all-on-4.synonyme.2.text: immediate treatment for a toothless jaw

leistung.all-on-4.teaser.text: When a jaw is badly damaged or has no teeth left, a bridge fitted to four to six carefully positioned implants can carry the entire jaw. Often a fixed temporary set of teeth can be fitted on the very day of the procedure – so you don't go home without teeth.

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.faq.0.ant.text: It's administered by a specialist anaesthetist and monitored throughout. Beforehand, there's a consultation to review your medical history. For healthy people, the risk is very low.

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.faq.1.ant.text: No. You'll need someone to accompany you, and you mustn't drive or make important decisions for 24 hours.

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.faq.1.fra.text: Can I go home alone afterwards?

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance only covers the anaesthetic in certain cases, for example with a proven phobia or disability. Otherwise it must be paid for privately.

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.kosten.text: Anaesthetic 600 to 1,500 € in addition to treatment

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.kurz.text: Extensive treatment in a single session – you sleep, we work.

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.patienten.text: Is dental treatment under general anaesthetic safe?

leistung.behandlung-in-narkose.teaser.text: For severe anxiety, a strong gag reflex, or very extensive treatment needs, a general anaesthetic is a good solution. An anaesthetist monitors you throughout while we take care of everything necessary in one session.

leistung.cmd-behandlung.dauer.text: Diagnosis 60 to 90 minutes, treatment over several months

leistung.cmd-behandlung.faq.0.antwort.text: Typical signs are clicking or grinding in the jaw joint, restricted mouth opening, morning tension in the cheek muscles, recurring headaches around the temples, and ear noises with no ENT findings. Several of these signs often occur together.

leistung.cmd-behandlung.faq.0.frage.text: How do I know if it might be TMJ disorder?

leistung.cmd-behandlung.faq.1.antwort.text: Many people notice an initial improvement after a few weeks with the splint. Stabilisation usually takes three to six months. In more pronounced cases, we work together with physiotherapy.

leistung.cmd-behandlung.faq.1.frage.text: How long does the treatment take?

leistung.cmd-behandlung.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance covers the splint where the findings justify it. The instrumental functional analysis is a private service.

leistung.cmd-behandlung.kurz.text: When your jaw, neck or ears ache and no one can find the cause.

leistung.cmd-behandlung.patientenfrage.text: Could my headaches be coming from my jaw?

leistung.cmd-behandlung.teaser.text: Temporomandibular dysfunction (TMD) occurs when the teeth, jaw joints and chewing muscles don't work together properly. The symptoms often show up far from the jaw – as headaches, ringing in the ears or neck tension. We measure your jaw function systematically and treat the underlying cause.

leistung.dentosophie.ablauf.0.text.text: We look at how breathing, tongue position, lip closure, chewing and swallowing work together – and what has fallen out of sync.

leistung.dentosophie.ablauf.1.text.text: A soft, mouthguard-shaped training appliance. It supports correct tongue position, encourages a natural swallowing pattern and promotes nasal breathing.

leistung.dentosophie.ablauf.2.text.text: Myofunctional exercises to correct the muscle imbalance. Active participation is part of the concept – new movement patterns are practised, not acquired on their own.

leistung.dentosophie.ablauf.3.text.text: Over six to twelve months, we monitor the progress and adjust the appliance and exercises as needed.

leistung.dentosophie.dauer.text: About six to twelve months, with regular check-up appointments

leistung.dentosophie.faq.0.antwort.text: For children and adolescents during development, as well as for adults. It is a gentle approach wherever functional issues play a role: mouth breathing, incorrect tongue position, abnormal swallowing, grinding, clenching or jaw misalignment. It is often used alongside other dental treatments.

leistung.dentosophie.faq.1.antwort.text: An elastic training device shaped like a dental arch, made of plastic. It supports tongue function, lip closure, swallowing and nasal breathing. During the therapy phase, it is worn regularly together with the accompanying exercises.

leistung.dentosophie.faq.2.antwort.text: This depends on the findings, age and treatment goal. As a rule, it takes around six to twelve months. In individual cases, longer-term support may be advisable.

leistung.dentosophie.faq.2.frage.text: How long does Dentosophie treatment take?

leistung.dentosophie.faq.3.antwort.text: Statutory health insurers in Germany generally do not cover Dentosophie. For privately insured patients and those with private supplementary dental insurance, cover depends on the specific policy. We will advise you in detail about the process and costs before treatment begins.

leistung.dentosophie.faq.3.frage.text: Does health insurance cover the cost?

leistung.dentosophie.faq.4.antwort.text: Dentosophie works on function, while a brace works on position. Where a misalignment has developed due to an unfavourable pattern – mouth breathing, incorrect swallowing – Dentosophie addresses the cause. Where the position itself is the problem, orthodontic treatment is unavoidable. Which applies in your case will become clear from the examination.

leistung.dentosophie.faq.4.frage.text: When does Dentosophie make sense, and when is a brace needed?

leistung.dentosophie.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance in Germany does not usually cover Dentosophy. For private insurance and supplementary dental insurance, it depends on the tariff – we will discuss the process and costs with you before starting.

leistung.dentosophie.kurz.text: Bringing breathing, tongue position and bite into balance – without braces.

leistung.dentosophie.patientenfrage.text: Can misaligned teeth be treated without fixed braces?

leistung.dentosophie.teaser.text: Dentosophy addresses the root of many problems: breathing, tongue position, lip closure, chewing and swallowing. A soft training appliance, combined with exercises, gradually helps change unconscious patterns – in children and adults alike.

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.faq.0.antwort.text: Considerably less than with a medical CT scan and, depending on the device and field size, roughly equivalent to a few days of natural background radiation. We only take a scan when there is a clear reason for it, and we always choose the smallest possible image field.

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.faq.1.antwort.text: Yes. If you wish, you can have the data on a digital file – for example, for a second opinion or for other specialists involved in your treatment.

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.faq.1.frage.text: Can I take the scan with me?

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.kasse.text: Usually a private fee, in some cases covered by German statutory health insurance.

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.kurz.text: Three-dimensional imaging for planning where every millimetre counts.

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.patientenfrage.text: How much radiation exposure does a CBCT scan involve?

leistung.dvt-3d-roentgen.teaser.text: Digital volume tomography shows the jaw, teeth and nerve pathways in three dimensions. It is used when a two-dimensional X-ray does not provide enough certainty – for example before implant placement or wisdom tooth surgery.

leistung.feste-zahnspange.faq.0.antwort.text: After fitting and after each adjustment, your teeth feel sensitive to pressure for two to three days. This is uncomfortable but manageable – soft food helps during this time.

leistung.feste-zahnspange.faq.1.antwort.text: No. Teeth can be moved at any age, as long as the gums are healthy. In adults, treatment tends to take a little longer, and any existing gum disease must be treated first.

leistung.feste-zahnspange.faq.1.frage.text: Am I too old for braces at 40?

leistung.feste-zahnspange.kasse.text: For children and teenagers from KIG grade 3 upwards, statutory health insurance covers standard treatment. The 20 percent personal contribution is refunded once treatment is successfully completed.

leistung.feste-zahnspange.kurz.text: The most reliable method for pronounced misalignments – also available as an invisible option.

leistung.feste-zahnspange.patientenfrage.text: Fixed braces or aligners – which suits my bite?

leistung.feste-zahnspange.teaser.text: Fixed braces can move teeth in ways that aligners cannot. Besides classic brackets, there are tooth-coloured ceramic brackets and lingual systems, which sit on the inside of the teeth and are invisible from the outside.

leistung.fissurenversiegelung.faq.0.antw.text: It wears down over the years and is checked at your regular appointments. If needed, it's topped up – this is quick and painless.

leistung.fissurenversiegelung.kasse.text: Sealing the permanent molars is covered by statutory health insurance for children and teenagers. Additional teeth are private.

leistung.fissurenversiegelung.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance for permanent molars

leistung.fissurenversiegelung.kurz.text: Sealing the deep grooves in molars before decay can start.

leistung.fissurenversiegelung.teaser.text: The chewing surfaces of the permanent molars have deep grooves that a toothbrush can't reach. A thin coat of resin seals them – painless, no drilling, and done within minutes.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.0.antw.text: We recommend two to four appointments a year, depending on how well oral hygiene works at home and whether you have had gum disease in the past.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.0.frag.text: How often should an implant be checked?

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.faq.1.antw.text: An inflammation of the tissue around the implant which, untreated, breaks down bone and in the worst case costs you the implant. It does not hurt at first – which is why regular checks matter so much.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.kasse.text: A private service. Where an implant already exists, supplementary insurance often contributes.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.kurz.text: Specialised aftercare for implants – so they last a lifetime.

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.patientenf.text: How do I care for my dental implants properly?

leistung.implantat-prophylaxe.teaser.text: Implants cannot decay, but they can lose the bone they stand in if the surrounding tissue becomes inflamed. Implant maintenance checks exactly that and cleans the implant surfaces with instruments made for the purpose.

leistung.inlays-onlays.faq.0.antwort.text: Considerably longer than a composite filling – typically ten to fifteen years or more. Ceramic doesn't shrink as it sets, so the seal at the edges stays tighter over the years.

leistung.inlays-onlays.faq.0.frage.text: How long does a ceramic inlay last?

leistung.inlays-onlays.kasse.text: Fixed allowance at the level of an amalgam or composite filling, with the difference paid privately.

leistung.inlays-onlays.kurz.text: Custom-fitted ceramic inlays for larger cavities in back teeth.

leistung.inlays-onlays.patientenfrage.text: When is an inlay worth it compared to a composite filling?

leistung.inlays-onlays.teaser.text: When a cavity is too large for a filling but the tooth is still too healthy for a crown, an inlay is the right choice. It's made to fit precisely in a laboratory from ceramic and then bonded in place – sturdier and longer-lasting than a composite filling.

leistung.karies-behandlung.faq.0.antwort.text: In very early stages, yes. Early decay in the enamel can be stopped with fluoride treatment or treated with a resin infiltration technique, without drilling. Once the decay has reached the dentine, it needs to be removed mechanically.

leistung.karies-behandlung.faq.0.frage.text: Can tooth decay go away without drilling?

leistung.karies-behandlung.faq.1.antwort.text: Pain only develops once the decay gets close to the nerve. Until then, it can grow unnoticed for months. That's exactly why check-ups are so valuable – they find what you can't feel yourself.

leistung.karies-behandlung.faq.1.frage.text: Why doesn't my tooth hurt, even though there's decay there?

leistung.karies-behandlung.kasse.text: German statutory health insurance covers fillings in tooth-coloured material throughout the mouth. More elaborate layering techniques involve a patient contribution.

leistung.karies-behandlung.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance; high-quality fillings 80 to 250 € patient contribution

leistung.karies-behandlung.kurz.text: Removing decay and sealing the tooth securely – while preserving as much healthy tooth as possible.

leistung.karies-behandlung.patientenfrag.text: Can tooth decay be treated without drilling?

leistung.karies-behandlung.teaser.text: The longer tooth decay goes unnoticed, the more involved the treatment becomes. Caught early, a small filling is often enough. We work with magnification and, where appropriate, particularly gentle methods to preserve as much healthy tooth structure as possible.

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.0.antwort.text: Studies and experience suggest fifteen to twenty years, often longer. What matters most is how well the crown margin is cared for and whether you grind your teeth at night.

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.0.frage.text: How long does a ceramic crown last?

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.1.antwort.text: Not necessarily. As long as the nerve is healthy, it stays in place. Root canal treatment is only needed if the nerve is already inflamed or has died.

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.1.frage.text: Does the tooth need root canal treatment first?

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.2.antwort.text: Usually one to two weeks. Because we make crowns in our own in-house dental laboratory, turnaround times are often shorter than with external labs.

leistung.keramik-kronen.faq.2.frage.text: How long will I need to live with a temporary crown?

leistung.keramik-kronen.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance pays a fixed subsidy towards standard treatment. For all-ceramic crowns on back teeth, you cover the difference yourself. A fully completed bonus record book increases the subsidy by up to 30 per cent.

leistung.keramik-kronen.kurz.text: When too little of the tooth is left – a crown that looks like a real tooth.

leistung.keramik-kronen.patientenfrage.text: When does a tooth need a crown rather than a filling?

leistung.keramik-kronen.teaser.text: A crown covers the damaged tooth completely, restoring its shape and strength. All-ceramic crowns come very close to matching the translucency of natural teeth and need no metal core that might later show through as a dark rim.

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.faq.0.antwort.text: An adult should keep helping with brushing until your child can write fluently – usually around age eight. Before that, children lack the fine motor skills needed for the inner surfaces and back molars.

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.faq.0.frage.text: From what age can my child brush their teeth alone?

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.kasse.text: Individual preventive care is covered by German statutory health insurance twice a year for children aged 6 to 17. Separate early detection services are available for children under 6.

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.kosten.text: Covered by German statutory health insurance for children aged 6 to 17

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.kurz.text: Brushing practice, fluoride treatment and check-ups – playful rather than preachy.

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.patientenfrage.text: What happens during preventive care for children?

leistung.kinderprophylaxe.teaser.text: In children's preventive care, we practise brushing with your child in the spots they can't yet reach themselves, use dye to show up plaque, and protect the teeth with fluoride varnish.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.0.antwort.text: As soon as the first tooth appears, and by the first birthday at the latest. The first appointments are just for getting to know each other and for advice – your child should experience the practice as a harmless place, before anything ever needs to be treated.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.0.frage.text: At what age should we come in?

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.1.antwort.text: Yes. Baby teeth hold the space open for the permanent teeth, and an infection can damage the permanent tooth underneath. Besides, decay hurts children too.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.1.frage.text: Does a hole in a baby tooth really need treatment?

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.2.antwort.text: It's best to stay neutral and avoid promises like “it won't hurt at all” – such phrases only draw attention to the possibility of pain. Just tell them that someone wants to look at and count their teeth. We'll take care of the rest.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.faq.2.frage.text: How can I prepare my child for the appointment?

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.kasse.text: Dental check-ups from the age of 6 months, as well as six-monthly examinations, are fully covered by German statutory health insurance. Fissure sealing of the permanent molars is also covered.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.kosten.text: Usually no extra charge for children

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.kurz.text: Dental care that children are happy to come back to.

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.patientenfrage.text: When should my child first visit the dentist?

leistung.kinderzahnarzt.teaser.text: With children, one thing matters most: the first impression must never be frightening. We take time to get to know them, explain every instrument in a child-friendly way, and only begin treatment once trust has been built. This shapes their attitude towards the dentist for life.

leistung.knirscherschiene.faq.0.antwort.text: Signs include flattened tooth edges, sensitive teeth in the morning, tense cheek muscles, and tooth imprints on the edge of the tongue. Often it's a partner who first notices the sound.

leistung.knirscherschiene.faq.0.frage.text: How do I know if I grind my teeth at night?

leistung.knirscherschiene.faq.1.antwort.text: Most people do, within a few nights. If the splint feels uncomfortable, we adjust it – a splint left in a drawer protects nothing.

leistung.knirscherschiene.faq.1.frage.text: Do you get used to wearing the splint?

leistung.knirscherschiene.kasse.text: With a documented finding, statutory health insurance covers the standard splint.

leistung.knirscherschiene.kurz.text: Protection for your teeth if you clench or grind at night.

leistung.knirscherschiene.patientenfrage.text: How do I know if I grind my teeth at night?

leistung.knirscherschiene.teaser.text: Nighttime grinding produces forces many times greater than normal chewing. An individually made splint spreads these forces and protects the enamel, fillings, crowns and jaw joints.

leistung.knochenaufbau.dauer.text: Procedure 45 to 120 minutes, healing 4 to 9 months

leistung.knochenaufbau.faq.0.antwort.text: For smaller defects, we usually use certified graft material, which the body gradually replaces with its own bone. For larger reconstructions, the patient's own bone may be more suitable, which we take from the jaw area.

leistung.knochenaufbau.faq.0.frage.text: Where does the bone come from?

leistung.knochenaufbau.faq.1.antwort.text: It is a routine procedure backed by very good clinical evidence. The sinus membrane is lifted, not cut through. Thanks to prior 3D planning, we know the exact anatomical conditions before the procedure.

leistung.knochenaufbau.kasse.text: Usually a private service as part of implant treatment.

leistung.knochenaufbau.kurz.text: Building a foundation where the jawbone is no longer sufficient for an implant.

leistung.knochenaufbau.patientenfrage.text: What happens during bone grafting and how long does healing take?

leistung.knochenaufbau.teaser.text: When a tooth has been missing for a long time, the jawbone in that area gradually breaks down. Using the patient's own bone or a biological substitute material, this volume can be rebuilt so that an implant has secure support.

leistung.kreidezaehne.dauer.text: 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the stage

leistung.kreidezaehne.faq.0.antwort.text: The cause has not been fully established. Influences during pregnancy and the first years of life are being discussed. What is certain is that it is not down to poor tooth brushing – for many parents, this is an important relief.

leistung.kreidezaehne.faq.1.antwort.text: The chronically irritated tooth nerve responds differently. We take this into account, use adapted techniques and, for more pronounced cases, can treat under sedation on request.

leistung.kreidezaehne.faq.1.frage.text: Why does anaesthetic work less well on chalky teeth?

leistung.kreidezaehne.faq.2.antwort.text: The enamel does not regenerate. With intensive fluoride treatment, sealing and, where needed, crowns, the teeth can be well protected and preserved until a permanent solution becomes possible later on.

leistung.kreidezaehne.faq.2.frage.text: Will the teeth stay like this forever?

leistung.kreidezaehne.kasse.text: Treatment is covered by German statutory health insurance. Additional protective measures are sometimes private.

leistung.kreidezaehne.kosten.text: Basic treatment covered by statutory health insurance, intensive prevention private

leistung.kreidezaehne.kurz.text: Yellowish, crumbly teeth in children – recognise, protect, and treat painlessly.

leistung.kreidezaehne.patientenfrage.text: What are chalky teeth and what can be done about them?

leistung.kreidezaehne.teaser.text: With chalky teeth, the enamel forms with too little mineral content from birth. The teeth are very sensitive, break more easily and respond poorly to anaesthetic. Early detection and intensive protective treatment can preserve a great deal.

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.faq.0.antw.text: Depending on size and location, around five to ten years. Small fillings last longer than large ones. If a very large part of the tooth is affected, an inlay or partial crown is the more durable option.

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.faq.0.frag.text: How long does a composite filling last?

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.faq.1.antw.text: Intact amalgam fillings don't need to be removed as a precaution – every replacement costs healthy tooth substance. Replacing them makes sense if the filling is leaking, decay has developed underneath, or you wish to for personal reasons. In that case, we take protective measures against mercury vapour.

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.faq.1.frag.text: Should I have my old amalgam fillings replaced?

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.kasse.text: Since amalgam was phased out, tooth-coloured fillings have been covered by statutory health insurance throughout the mouth.

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance, layering technique 80 to 200 € out-of-pocket cost

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.kurz.text: Composite fillings that are indistinguishable in colour from the tooth.

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.patientenf.text: What does a tooth-coloured filling cost, and how long does it last?

leistung.kunststofffuellungen.teaser.text: Modern composite fillings are built up in layers and hardened with light. They bond directly to the tooth, so less tooth substance needs to be removed than in the past – and the colour can be matched exactly.

leistung.lachgas.dauer.text: Takes effect immediately, wears off after 10 to 15 minutes

leistung.lachgas.faq.0.antwort.text: After breathing pure oxygen for about 15 minutes, the effect has fully worn off. Unlike with general anaesthesia or tablets, you may usually drive yourself afterwards – we confirm this individually.

leistung.lachgas.faq.1.antwort.text: Yes, it has been well studied in children and is often used when treatment would not otherwise be possible. The child must be able to breathe through the nose.

leistung.lachgas.faq.1.frage.text: Is nitrous oxide suitable for children too?

leistung.lachgas.kurz.text: Relaxed and responsive – the gentle stage between local anaesthetic and general anaesthesia.

leistung.lachgas.patientenfrage.text: What does treatment with nitrous oxide feel like?

leistung.lachgas.teaser.text: Nitrous oxide is breathed in through a small nasal mask and takes effect within a few minutes. You stay awake and responsive, but feel noticeably more relaxed. The effect wears off completely after a short time.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.faq.0.a.text: No. Healthy gums do not bleed, not even when brushing or flossing. Bleeding is a sign of inflammation and the earliest warning you can notice yourself. Please don't try to brush it away – have it checked instead.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.faq.1.a.text: Lost bone and receded gums do not grow back on their own. What we can achieve is stopping the inflammation and keeping the condition stable. In selected cases, regenerative or plastic surgical procedures are possible.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.faq.2.a.text: Yes. There are well-documented links with diabetes, cardiovascular disease and pregnancy complications. Conversely, poorly controlled diabetes makes treatment more difficult. This is why we ask about any pre-existing conditions.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.faq.2.f.text: Does gum disease affect my general health?

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.kasse.text: Since 2021, there has been a structured periodontitis treatment pathway that the German statutory health insurance covers, including two years of follow-up care. This requires a documented diagnosis.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance where indicated; additional treatments cost €200 to €800

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.kurz.text: Stopping gum disease before it costs you bone and teeth.

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.patient.text: My gums bleed – is that already periodontitis?

leistung.parodontitis-behandlung.teaser.text: Periodontitis is the most common cause of tooth loss in adults – and for a long time, it doesn't hurt at all. We clean the gum pockets thoroughly, remove the bacteria, and follow up with you closely afterwards so the infection doesn't come back.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ab.text: We look at your teeth and gums and stain the plaque so it becomes visible – you can see for yourself where the problem areas are.
Soft and hard deposits are loosened with a powder jet and ultrasound – no scraping with sharp instruments.
The tooth surfaces are smoothed and protected with fluoride. Smooth surfaces give bacteria less to cling to.
You get concrete tips on brushes, technique and aids – based on what we actually found.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.fa.text: In the vast majority of cases, no. We work with a powder jet rather than sharp hand instruments. If your gums are inflamed or your tooth necks are sensitive, tell us – we will numb those areas locally.

Twice a year for most adults. If you are prone to gum inflammation, smoke, wear braces or have implants, three to four appointments a year are better. We agree the rhythm together, based on your findings.
How often is a professional clean worthwhile?
Your teeth return to their natural colour, because external staining from coffee, tea or red wine disappears. It will not make them lighter than your natural shade – that requires whitening.
Will it make my teeth whiter?

Wait about an hour after the fluoride treatment. After that we recommend avoiding strongly colouring food and drink such as red wine, coffee or curry for around 24 hours – freshly polished surfaces take on colour more readily at first.
Can I eat and drink straight afterwards?

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ka.text: Statutory health insurance usually does not cover professional cleaning. Many funds do contribute through bonus schemes – ask yours beforehand.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ko.text: 150 to 250 € per hour of treatment, depending on the work involved

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.ku.text: A thorough clean where your toothbrush and floss cannot reach.

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.pa.text: How often should I have my teeth professionally cleaned?

leistung.professionelle-zahnreinigung.te.text: During a professional clean we remove plaque and staining from the places you cannot reach at home. This prevents decay and gum inflammation, and leaves your teeth noticeably smoother and brighter.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.0.antwort.text: The powder jet also reaches the spaces between teeth and the gum pockets, where hand instruments struggle. At the same time it removes less tooth substance. To you it feels like a warm jet of water rather than scraping.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.0.frage.text: Why is the powder jet better than classic scraping?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.1.antwort.text: Especially then. The erythritol powder we use is very fine and is applied with water at body temperature. Many people with sensitive tooth necks find this method considerably more comfortable than a classic clean.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.1.frage.text: Is it suitable for sensitive teeth?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.2.antwort.text: Yes. The method was developed explicitly for implant surfaces and restorations as well, and does not attack ceramic or titanium. Do tell us what work you have in your mouth – we adjust the powder and pressure accordingly.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.faq.2.frage.text: Does it work with implants, crowns and veneers?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.kasse.text: A private service, not included in the statutory catalogue. Private insurers usually reimburse the treatment in full.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.kurz.text: Cleaning to the GBT protocol – no scraping, just a warm powder jet.

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.patientenfrage.text: What is the difference between Prophylaxis 4.0 and an ordinary clean?

leistung.prophylaxe-4-0.teaser.text: Prophylaxis 4.0 is our cleaning concept following the GBT protocol. Instead of scraping with sharp hand instruments, we loosen deposits with a warm, fine powder jet. It is more thorough, gentler on enamel and gums – and for most people considerably more pleasant.

leistung.retainer.faq.0.antwort.text: Yes, if you want the result to stay stable for good. The forces that push teeth back fade over the years, but they never fully disappear. A bonded retainer doesn't get in the way of daily life and just needs regular check-ups.

leistung.retainer.faq.0.frage.text: Do I really need to keep the retainer forever?

leistung.retainer.kurz.text: Stabilisation after orthodontic treatment – without it, teeth drift back.

leistung.retainer.patientenfrage.text: How long do I need to wear a retainer?

leistung.retainer.teaser.text: A retainer keeps the treatment result stable in the long term. It's usually a thin wire bonded to the inside of the front teeth, invisible from the outside. Removable splints for night-time wear are also an option.

leistung.smile-design.faq.0.antwort.text: The digital preview shows shape, length and proportions very accurately. It becomes even more reliable with the mock-up: here, we place the planned shape as a thin plastic layer directly onto your teeth, without any grinding. You can then see and feel the result on your own face.

leistung.smile-design.faq.1.antwort.text: That's exactly what this step is for. As long as nothing has been ground down, any change can be made without any loss. We adjust the plan until you're happy with it – only then does the actual treatment begin.

leistung.smile-design.faq.1.frage.text: What if I don't like the result?

leistung.smile-design.kosten.text: €250 to €600 for the planning, usually offset against the cost if you go ahead

leistung.smile-design.kurz.text: See your new smile on screen before a single tooth is treated.

leistung.smile-design.patientenfrage.text: Can I see beforehand how my teeth will look afterwards?

leistung.smile-design.teaser.text: With digital smile design, we plan your smile using photos, videos and a 3D scan – in relation to your face shape, lip line and expression. You see the result on screen beforehand, and can even try it out in your mouth as a temporary version before deciding.

leistung.sofortimplantate.faq.0.antwort.text: The requirement is that the socket is not inflamed and that there is enough stable bone for the implant to hold securely. If there is an acute infection, the tissue needs to heal first. The 3D scan shows in advance what is possible.

leistung.sofortimplantate.faq.0.frage.text: Who is suitable for an immediate implant?

leistung.sofortimplantate.faq.1.antwort.text: In the front tooth area, we usually fit a temporary tooth straight away, which is not put under full load. So you won't leave the practice with a visible gap.

leistung.sofortimplantate.faq.1.frage.text: Will I have a visible tooth straight away?

leistung.sofortimplantate.kasse.text: As with a regular implant: a fixed subsidy applies only to the dental restoration.

leistung.sofortimplantate.kurz.text: Tooth extraction and implant placement in one session.

leistung.sofortimplantate.patientenfrage.text: Can I get an implant straight after having a tooth removed?

leistung.sofortimplantate.teaser.text: Under certain conditions, the implant can be placed directly into the socket right after the tooth is removed. This saves one procedure, shortens the overall treatment, and protects the bone and gum line.

leistung.teilprothese.faq.0.antwort.text: A well-fitting denture stays reliably in place in the upper jaw through suction. In the lower jaw, staying in place is naturally more difficult – but even two implants used as press-stud anchors provide enormous stability.

leistung.teilprothese.faq.0.frage.text: Does the denture slip when speaking or eating?

leistung.teilprothese.faq.1.antwort.text: Usually two to four weeks. At first, speech and taste perception change. We schedule follow-up appointments to correct any sore spots early on.

leistung.teilprothese.faq.1.frage.text: How long does it take to get used to?

leistung.teilprothese.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance pays a fixed subsidy. If your income is low, a hardship provision may allow full cover of the standard treatment.

leistung.teilprothese.kurz.text: Removable replacement when several or all teeth are missing.

leistung.teilprothese.patientenfrage.text: How much does a denture cost, and will it stay in place while eating?

leistung.teilprothese.teaser.text: When larger gaps can no longer be treated with bridges, removable dentures restore both chewing function and appearance. Modern telescopic and precision-attachment dentures manage without visible metal clasps.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.0.text.text: We photograph and scan your teeth and talk about what bothers you. On screen you see a preview of the possible result.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.1.text.text: Depending on the starting point, very little or no enamel is removed. You get temporary shells so you can test shape and length in everyday life.

leistung.veneers.ablauf.2.text.text: The finished veneers are tried in, checked for colour and fit, and then bonded permanently.

leistung.veneers.faq.0.antwort.text: Considerably less than it used to be. With classic veneers about half a millimetre of enamel is removed. In suitable cases we work with non-prep veneers and no grinding at all. What is possible for you depends on tooth position and starting shape – we clarify that before the first cut.

leistung.veneers.faq.0.frage.text: Does a lot of healthy tooth have to be ground away?

leistung.veneers.faq.1.antwort.text: With good care and regular checks, ceramic veneers usually last ten to fifteen years, often longer. The greatest risk to them is grinding your teeth at night – so we check for that beforehand and fit you with a splint if needed.

leistung.veneers.faq.2.antwort.text: Not if they are carefully planned. Ceramic transmits light much like natural enamel. What matters is that shape, length and colour suit your face – which is why we work with a preview and temporaries before anything becomes final.

leistung.veneers.faq.2.frage.text: Can people tell they are veneers?

leistung.veneers.faq.3.antwort.text: If enamel has been removed, the restoration is permanent – the tooth will always need a facing. Non-prep veneers, by contrast, can in principle be taken off again. We tell you clearly beforehand which route applies to you.

leistung.veneers.kasse.text: Purely cosmetic veneers are a private service and receive no contribution from statutory insurance. Where there is a demonstrable medical indication – after an accident, for instance – part of the cost may be reimbursed.

leistung.veneers.kosten.text: 900 to 1,800 € per tooth, depending on material and effort

leistung.veneers.kurz.text: Wafer-thin ceramic shells that change the shape and colour of the visible teeth.

leistung.veneers.patientenfrage.text: What do veneers cost and how long do they last?

leistung.veneers.teaser.text: Veneers are thin ceramic shells bonded to the front of your anterior teeth. They correct discolouration, small gaps, chipped edges and slight misalignment – usually within two to three appointments.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.0.antwort.text: Usually two to three days. Swelling and tightness are at their worst on the second day and then ease off. If possible, schedule the procedure so it falls before a free weekend.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.0.frage.text: How long will I be off sick afterwards?

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.1.antwort.text: Both are possible. Having all four done in one session means just one recovery period – most people choose this, often with sedation. Doing them one at a time is gentler if you can't take much time off work or if you have pre-existing conditions.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.1.frage.text: All four at once, or one at a time?

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.2.antwort.text: In the lower jaw, a nerve runs close to the roots. That's precisely why, in critical cases, we take a 3D scan beforehand that shows the distance to the millimetre. Temporary numbness is rare, and permanent numbness very rare – we'll discuss your individual risk with you before the procedure.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.faq.2.frage.text: Can a nerve be damaged during this?

leistung.weisheitszaehne.kasse.text: Removal is covered by statutory health insurance when there's a medical reason for it. Purely preventive removal without a clinical finding, as well as sedation, must be paid for privately.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance if medically indicated, sedation an extra 250 to 600 €

leistung.weisheitszaehne.kurz.text: A routine procedure with careful planning – sedation is available if you'd like it.

leistung.weisheitszaehne.patientenfrage.text: Do wisdom teeth always have to come out, and how long am I off afterwards?

leistung.weisheitszaehne.teaser.text: Wisdom teeth don't always have to come out. But if they're growing at an angle, inflamed, or putting neighbouring teeth at risk, removal makes sense. A 3D scan shows us exactly where they sit in relation to the nerve beforehand.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.dauer.text: 1 to 2 appointments of 60 to 120 minutes each

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.0.ant.text: That reputation dates back to a time before modern anaesthetics. Today, the tooth is reliably numbed throughout the treatment. What actually hurts is usually the infection beforehand – the treatment puts an end to that pain.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.1.ant.text: For a first treatment carried out under the microscope, studies show success rates of around 85 to 95 per cent. For a repeat treatment, the rates are lower. No one can honestly guarantee an outcome – we'll tell you frankly beforehand what the prospects look like in your case.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.1.fra.text: What are the chances of success?

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.2.ant.text: For back teeth, almost always. A root-treated tooth becomes more brittle and can easily crack without a crown. For front teeth with little loss of tooth structure, a filling is often enough.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.2.fra.text: Does the tooth need a crown afterwards?

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.3.ant.text: Your own tooth has a natural support structure that no implant can fully replace – that's why we try to save it first. But if the tooth is badly damaged or has already failed treatment more than once, an implant can be the more stable option. We'll set out both paths for you, with costs and prognosis side by side.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.faq.3.fra.text: Wouldn't an implant make more sense?

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.kasse.text: The statutory health insurance covers treatment on front teeth and, under certain conditions, on molars. Additional services such as microscope use and mechanical preparation must be paid for privately.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.kurz.text: Saving your own tooth when the nerve is inflamed.

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.patienten.text: Is root canal treatment painful, and does it really save the tooth?

leistung.wurzelkanalbehandlung.teaser.text: During root canal treatment, inflamed tissue is removed from inside the tooth, the canal system is cleaned and sealed tightly. With the help of a microscope and mechanical instruments, even difficult, curved canals can now be reliably treated.

leistung.zahnarztangst.dauer.text: Initial consultation 30 to 45 minutes, no treatment

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.0.antwort.text: No. The first appointment is just a conversation – you don't have to sit in the treatment chair if you don't want to. We look together at what you need and decide how to proceed from there. Nothing happens without warning.

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.0.frage.text: Do I have to undergo treatment at the first appointment?

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.1.antwort.text: No. Many of our patients come back after years away. We assess, we don't judge – and we'll tell you honestly and without drama what needs to be done.

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.1.frage.text: Will I be judged for my long gaps between treatments?

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.2.antwort.text: Then we stop. We agree on a hand signal beforehand that means an immediate pause. Getting that control back makes all the difference for many people.

leistung.zahnarztangst.faq.2.frage.text: What if I can't go on partway through treatment?

leistung.zahnarztangst.kasse.text: Dental treatment is covered by statutory health insurance; sedation and general anaesthetic are usually paid for privately.

leistung.zahnarztangst.kosten.text: Consultation covered by statutory health insurance, sedation €250 to €600

leistung.zahnarztangst.kurz.text: For anyone who's been putting off that appointment for years.

leistung.zahnarztangst.patientenfrage.text: I'm very afraid of the dentist – what happens at the first appointment?

leistung.zahnarztangst.teaser.text: Dental anxiety isn't a character flaw – it's a very common and treatable reaction. With us, you set the pace: the first appointment is simply a conversation, with no treatment involved. Everything else happens only once you're ready.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.dauer.text: 60 to 90 minutes in the practice, 10 to 14 days at home

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.0.antwort.text: Not when carried out properly. The active ingredient penetrates the tooth and breaks down colour molecules there, without removing any substance. It's important that teeth and gums are healthy beforehand – that's why we always examine and professionally clean first, before whitening.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.0.frage.text: Does whitening damage the tooth enamel?

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.1.antwort.text: Ceramic and composite material do not react to the whitening agent. If you have visible crowns or fillings, we plan for this: whitening comes first, then the restorations are matched to the new shade.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.1.frage.text: Why won't my crowns and fillings get lighter?

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.2.antwort.text: Usually one to three years. Coffee, tea, red wine and smoking shorten this noticeably. With a touch-up using your individual tray, you can keep the result stable at low cost.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.2.frage.text: How long does the result last?

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.3.antwort.text: Temporary sensitivity to cold can occur, usually settling within one to two days. We use gels containing potassium nitrate and fluoride, which noticeably ease this.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.faq.3.frage.text: Will my teeth become sensitive afterwards?

leistung.zahnaufhellung.kasse.text: Private treatment, not covered by German statutory health insurance.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.kurz.text: Teeth several shades lighter – controlled and without damaging the enamel.

leistung.zahnaufhellung.teaser.text: With whitening, we lighten the teeth using an active gel that breaks down colour pigments in the tooth. Depending on the starting shade, several shades lighter are possible. In the practice, this can be done in one session; with take-home trays it works a little more slowly and gently.

leistung.zahnbruecken.faq.0.antwort.text: If the neighbouring teeth are healthy and undamaged, an implant often makes more sense – it preserves healthy tooth structure. If the neighbouring teeth need crowns anyway, a bridge is often the more sensible and more affordable option. We will explain both options, along with the costs and consequences, before you decide.

leistung.zahnbruecken.faq.1.antwort.text: In certain cases in the front tooth area, yes – with an adhesive bridge, which is attached using just one wing to the back of a neighbouring tooth. This is a good interim solution, especially for young people with congenitally missing teeth.

leistung.zahnbruecken.faq.1.frage.text: Can a bridge be fitted without grinding down the teeth?

leistung.zahnbruecken.kasse.text: Fixed subsidy from the statutory health insurance for standard care, increased with a bonus record.

leistung.zahnbruecken.kosten.text: €1,200 to €2,800 depending on span and material

leistung.zahnbruecken.kurz.text: Closing a gap by letting the neighbouring teeth carry the new tooth.

leistung.zahnbruecken.patientenfrage.text: Bridge or implant – which is better for a gap in your teeth?

leistung.zahnbruecken.teaser.text: A bridge replaces one or more missing teeth, supported by the neighbouring teeth. It sits firmly, can be used straight away and needs no surgery – but unlike an implant, the neighbouring teeth have to be ground down to hold it.

leistung.zahnentfernung.faq.0.antwort.text: For 24 hours: no smoking, no alcohol, no coffee, no dairy products, no rinsing and no exercise. Warmth and physical exertion can trigger further bleeding. Cool the area from the outside at intervals.

leistung.zahnentfernung.faq.1.antwort.text: In visible areas, usually yes, with a temporary tooth. In the back teeth, it depends on whether the opposing tooth would otherwise shift out of place. Ideally, we plan the permanent solution with you even before the extraction.

leistung.zahnentfernung.faq.1.frage.text: Should the gap be treated straight away?

leistung.zahnentfernung.kasse.text: Removal is covered by statutory health insurance. Bone-preserving measures are private.

leistung.zahnentfernung.kosten.text: Covered by statutory health insurance, additional measures charged according to effort

leistung.zahnentfernung.kurz.text: When a tooth can't be saved – removed gently, with an eye on what comes next.

leistung.zahnentfernung.patientenfrage.text: What should I be careful of after having a tooth removed?

leistung.zahnentfernung.teaser.text: Sometimes a tooth is so badly damaged that saving it no longer makes sense. We remove it as gently as possible while preserving the bony socket – this makes fitting an implant later on much easier.

leistung.zahnimplantate.ablauf.0.text.text: A CBCT scan shows bone volume and nerve pathways to the millimetre. From this, we plan the position and length of the implant on screen.

leistung.zahnimplantate.ablauf.1.text.text: Under local anaesthetic – or sedation if you prefer – the implant is placed into the jawbone. Most people find this less demanding than having a tooth removed.

leistung.zahnimplantate.ablauf.2.text.text: The bone fuses firmly with the implant surface. During this time you wear a temporary restoration, so you can eat and smile as normal.

leistung.zahnimplantate.ablauf.3.text.text: Once healing is complete, the new tooth is fitted – made in our own master lab and matched to your natural tooth colour.

leistung.zahnimplantate.dauer.text: Procedure 30 to 90 minutes, overall treatment 3 to 6 months

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.0.antwort.text: You won't feel anything during the procedure thanks to the local anaesthetic. Afterwards, there may be mild pain and swelling for one to three days – similar to having a tooth removed, and easily managed with standard painkillers. If you feel very anxious, the procedure can also be done under sedation.

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.1.antwort.text: After ten years, over ninety per cent of implants are still in function. What matters most is consistent aftercare, healthy gums and not smoking. Smoking significantly increases the risk of implant loss.

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.1.frage.text: How long does an implant last?

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.2.antwort.text: There is no upper age limit. What matters is general health and bone quality, not the year you were born. There is a lower limit, though: for teenagers, treatment waits until jaw growth is complete.

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.2.frage.text: Am I too old for an implant?

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.3.antwort.text: In that case, bone can be built up – depending on the extent needed, either at the same time as the implant is placed or in a preceding procedure. The 3D scan shows how much you would need.

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.3.frage.text: What if there isn't enough bone?

leistung.zahnimplantate.faq.4.antwort.text: Yes, made from zirconium oxide ceramic. They are white, tissue-friendly and an option for people with a titanium sensitivity or thin gum tissue in visible areas. Not every situation is suited to this – we will check this during planning.

leistung.zahnimplantate.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance pays a fixed subsidy for the denture attached to the implant, but not for the implant itself. The subsidy matches that for the comparable standard treatment.

leistung.zahnimplantate.kurz.text: An artificial tooth root made of titanium – firmly anchored, without grinding down neighbouring teeth.

leistung.zahnimplantate.patientenfrage.text: How does an implant procedure work, and does it hurt?

leistung.zahnimplantate.teaser.text: An implant replaces the tooth root and carries a crown, bridge or denture on top. It transfers chewing forces into the jawbone, keeping it active – an advantage no other type of denture can offer. The neighbouring teeth remain untouched.

leistung.zahnschmuck.faq.0.antwort.text: No, not if it's fitted and cared for properly. The tooth itself isn't harmed. It's important to brush thoroughly around the piece so plaque doesn't build up there.

leistung.zahnschmuck.faq.0.frage.text: Does tooth jewellery damage the tooth?

leistung.zahnschmuck.kurz.text: A small crystal or gold ornament, bonded on without drilling.

leistung.zahnschmuck.patientenfrage.text: Do you have to drill into the tooth for a tooth gem?

leistung.zahnschmuck.teaser.text: Tooth gems are bonded on using the same method as braces – without drilling and without any loss of tooth substance. They can be removed again at any time, leaving no trace.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.0.antwort.text: For the bonus booklet, one appointment per calendar year is enough for adults. Medically we recommend two – decay and gum inflammation often develop within a few months and do not hurt for a long time.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.1.antwort.text: Not routinely. We only take X-rays if there is a specific suspicion or the last images are old – typically every two years. Every image is explained and justified to you beforehand.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.2.antwort.text: No. We do not judge, we examine. A great many people come to us after a long break, and we go through what makes sense now, calmly and in an order that works for you.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.faq.2.frage.text: I have not been to a dentist for years. Will I be told off?

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kasse.text: Statutory health insurance covers two check-ups per year in full. Both appointments belong in your bonus booklet.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kosten.text: No charge for patients with statutory insurance

leistung.zahnvorsorge.kurz.text: The six-monthly check – short, painless and the best protection against expensive treatment.

leistung.zahnvorsorge.patientenfrage.text: What happens at a dental check-up?

leistung.zahnvorsorge.teaser.text: At a check-up we systematically examine your teeth, gums and oral tissues. Early decay and gum inflammation can be treated while the effort is still small – and the entry in your bonus booklet secures you higher insurance contributions towards dentures.
